paragraphs: He reported in the name of Shmuel; Taanit 6a and Yoma 22a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The terse אמר שמואל is read as Nehilai reporting in Shmuel’s name. The statement’s content is not supplied. ו. and כב. give 6a and 22a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
נהילאי is retained as Nehilai without normalizing to another name. The heading’s abbreviated title remains R'; Shmuel has no personal title here.
